Run two accounts of the same desktop app side by side on Windows — and have the sign-in land on the one you meant.

**These binaries are UNSIGNED.** Windows will show *"Windows protected your PC"*. Read [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/ammarzkhan/twinstance/blob/main/SECURITY.md) before running them, and verify your download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

**Privacy:** Twinstance collects nothing and transmits nothing. It contains no network code at all, so no data is transferred anywhere — with or without your consent. See [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/ammarzkhan/twinstance/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).

**Which file?** `Twinstance-<version>-standalone.exe` needs nothing installed. `Twinstance-<version>.exe` is far smaller but needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

Changes in this release: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ammarzkhan/twinstance/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
